name: AMC Accordion Rail
description: Side navigation drawn as a rail: every entry is a node on one line, groups open like an accordion with a smooth height morph, and the path from the current parent down to the current page glows along the rail.
useFor: Navigation lists with one level of sub entries in a Left Column or side region: Orders with Open, Backorders and Returns, Invoices with Drafts and Overdue, Admin with Users and Settings.
helpText: List template for side navigation with one level of sub lists. Every entry is a real link; the current entry gets aria-current=page, and a parent whose group holds the current page is shown on the current path. Entries with children render their link plus a native disclosure toggle, so groups open and close with the mouse, Enter or Space and without JavaScript; the current group starts open. In browsers that support ::details-content the group grows and shrinks smoothly. The rail lights up from the current parent down to the current page. Attribute 1 is a badge, hidden when empty. Template options: Icon rail clips the list to its icons and reveals it over the page on hover or keyboard focus, with a dot on icons that carry a badge; Compact tightens the rows; Panel puts the navigation on a card surface; Flowing light sends a light pulse along the lit rail. Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing animates; in forced-colors mode the rail and current entry use system colors.

templateOptions.name: Icon rail
templateOptions.help: Collapses the navigation to a narrow rail of icons. Hover or keyboard focus reveals the full list over the page; entries with a badge show a dot. Give every top-level entry an icon.

templateOptions.name: Compact
templateOptions.help: Shorter rows and smaller text for long navigation lists.

templateOptions.name: Panel
templateOptions.help: Places the navigation on a card surface with a soft shadow, for use on the page background.

templateOptions.name: Flowing light
templateOptions.help: A light pulse flows down the lit part of the rail and the current node pings. Stops under reduced motion.
